function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1 (12%). According to the documentation, `-1` means 'the customer did not supply an age'.", "implication": "These -1 values are not valid ages. They must be excluded from any calculation of mean age, because they are not measurements of age — they are missing data indicators. If included, they would bias the mean downward (since -1 < 0), which is invalid. Therefore, we must filter out rows where `customer_age == -1` before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
